objective: Test whether a low-resolution task-conditioned scout can propose one continuous rectangular ROI without consuming ground-truth geometry at inference time.
evidence_level: revealed development grouped cross-validation; calibration and test splits remain sealed

scout.input: original full image resized to long edge 256
scout.text_relevance: maximum cosine similarity from each projected visual group to non-image prompt token embeddings

ridge_heatmap_scale.heatmap_head: shared weighted ridge regression over per-cell projected features, text relevance, coordinates and task indicator
ridge_heatmap_scale.heatmap_target: anisotropic Gaussian centered on the labeled box with sigma equal to max(half box extent, one cell extent)
ridge_heatmap_scale.scale_head: ridge regression on pooled scout features predicts log box width and height

post_gate_action.pass: Run one out-of-fold predicted-ROI BF16 VLM quality evaluation against Dense.
post_gate_action.fail: Stop the current rectangular ROI controller branch without accessing calibration or test data. Do not tune scout depth, projection, ridge alpha, box size, scale multiplier or thresholds on this development set.
